regions.today: Dry with clear spells. Light southerly or variable breeze.
regions.tonight: Dry tonight with clear spells and a few possible mist patches. Lowest temperatures of -1 to 4 degrees with mostly light southerly or variable winds, increasing moderate southeasterly towards morning.
regions.tomorrow: Dry with some bright spells in the east at first. A band of rain and drizzle will move eastwards through the morning with a clearance to drier and brighter conditions following in the afternoon. Highest temperatures of 7 to 11 degrees, with moderate to fresh southeasterly winds easing light to moderate and veering southwesterly with the clearance of the rain.
